text:
alex: Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's AH Q&A. Thread to capture clarifications, links, and who's owning what. I'll start.

mia: Can we get a concrete timeline for Dedicated GA? The slide said "H2" — is that H2 Q3 or H2 Q4?

rachel: Short answer: target GA is mid-October. Concretely: feature freeze Sept 10, compliance sign-off Sept 30, GA Oct 15. Will post RFC link. :calendar:

alex: Thanks @rachel. Please add the exact rollout windows and opt-in docs.

tyler: Will do. Uploading the rollout checklist to the product repo by EOD. Link when ready.

sam: On Dedicated SLAs — what latency numbers should customers expect at GA?

rachel: SLA target: p95 < 220ms for text-gen on 8k context models under committed throughput. We're still tuning for 32k. Note this is for reserved capacity with the default batching policy.

mia: Who's owning the 32k tuning work? I can allocate an applied-ML engineer but need an owner from runtime.

dan: I'll own runtime side. Will coordinate with @mia. Dan -> assigns eng ticket INF-3281.

olivia: Quick doc ask: can we publish a short FAQ for customers about "model pinning" vs automatic routing? A plain-language section would help sales.

alex: Good ask. @olivia please draft the FAQ; @tyler will review. Target: 1-week draft.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Recorded meeting audio + slides -> https://redwood.example.com/ah/2026-03-23 (archived)

sam: Also flagged billing question: the example in the deck used averaged batching which hid burst pricing. Can we get an explicit worked example (burst vs reserved) for the pricing page?

rachel: Yes. Finance and product will prepare two short examples: small-scale app (50 rps) and high-throughput (2k rps). @sam please give a sample app profile you care about.

sam: Will link our demo app profile in INF-3410.

mia: Action items summary I pulled together:
- Dedicated GA timeline: rachel (owner), due 2026-09-30.
- Rollout checklist + repo PR: tyler, due today EOD.
- 32k tuning plan: dan + mia, create RFC INF-3281, due 2026-04-06.
- Model pinning FAQ: olivia, draft + tyler review, due 2026-03-30.
- Pricing worked examples: rachel + finance, due 2026-04-13.
- Customer-facing canary guide (how to run canaries using Redwood Console): alex + eng-sre, draft due 2026-04-06.

alex: Adding one more thing — public roadmap item request channel: we'll consolidate asks into the roadmap board. If you heard a feature ask in AH, please open a brief card (2-3 lines) with customer/impact and add label "AH-ask".

tyler: Noted. I'll create a template card in the board and broadcast it.

olivia: Small clarification from the security Q: Private deployment KMS integration — will HSM be available at GA?

rachel: HSM integration is targeted for the Private beta after GA. GA will support cloud KMS (AWS/GCP) only. We'll publish the Private roadmap item.

dan: For the engineering teams: quick kernel optimization spike tomorrow at 10am to measure p95 effects of a new attention fused op. Anyone who wants numbers join.

mia: I'll join. Adding it to my calendar. :eyes:

alex: Thanks all — if anyone wants to be added to an owner list or think an action item is missing, reply here. I'll post a follow-up doc with links to RFCs and tickets by tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
